title: SEBI Lowers Commodity Derivatives Stress-Testing Z-Score Limit to 5
summary: SEBI lowered Z-score limit for stress testing in commodity derivatives market from 10 to 5 under Core SGF framework.

blocks.content: SEBI lowered Z-score limit for stress testing in commodity derivatives market from 10 to 5 under Core SGF framework.

items: **Z-Score Threshold:** Lowered from **10 to 5** to ease compliance for market participants under Core Settlement Guarantee Fund (Core SGF).
**Historical Window:** Uses mean and sigma of returns over Margin Period of Risk (MPOR) across **15 years**.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Core SGF: Core Settlement Guarantee Fund maintained by Clearing Corporations.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ≠ **Threshold Reduction:** Z-score reduced from 10 to 5 (15-year MPOR window).
